info.title: Mailrust API
info.description: Send transactional email through your own Amazon SES. Auth: `Authorization: Bearer mr_live_…` (API key), or `Bearer mr_sess_…` (dashboard session) plus `X-Mailrust-Account: <account id>`.

422.description: Named by the first failed check

200.description: email,first_name,last_name,status,tags,created_at, then one column per field name

422.description: consent_required, file_too_large, not_utf8, bad_csv, empty_file, no_email_column, too_many_rows

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Same key + same body within 24 h returns the first email id

200.description: The archive page, served with a strict CSP

archive_slug.description: Set when the send starts: `/p/<newsletter slug>/<archive_slug>`.

exclude_tags.description: Tag ids: skip contacts with any of these.

include_tags.description: Tag ids: send only to contacts with any of these (empty = everyone subscribed).

wave.description: The last wave started (0 = none yet).

first_name_fallback.description: What readers without a first name see, when the issue greets by name.

html.description: The email as a reader without merge values sees it (fallbacks), footer included.

size_bytes.description: The largest copy any reader can get, in bytes (None until the body is a valid document).

CampaignRequest.description: Create and edit. Absent fields stay as they are; `preview_text: ""` clears it.

archive_hidden.description: Hide a sent issue from the public archive. Works in any status.

blocks.description: The editor document (Tiptap JSON). Saved when it is a document; the full rules run at send.

clicked.description: Readers who clicked (unique, bots left out).

opened.description: Readers who opened (unique, bots left out).

recipients.description: Emails queued or sent for this issue.

newsletter_name.description: None when the link is unknown; a used or expired link still names the newsletter.

signup_slug.description: The signup form's slug, for a "sign up again" link.

total.description: Contacts matching the filters, on every page.

blocked.description: The address is on the account's suppression list: nothing will be sent to it.

tags.description: Tag names; missing tags are created.

token.description: The full key. Shown only in this response.

file.description: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, ≤ 5 MB. The type is read from the bytes.

url.description: Where readers load it: `{WEB_URL}/img/{id}`, whatever the store.

line.description: Line in the file (1 = the header row).

consent.description: Must be `true`: these people agreed to get your emails.

file.description: UTF-8 CSV, ≤ 20 MB, ≤ 100,000 rows, a header row with an `email` column.

tag_id.description: A tag added to every row.

errors.description: The first 1,000 bad rows. Empty in the import list: get one import to see them.

closed_reason.description: Why the form is closed, when it is.

postal_address.description: Shown in the footer of every issue; required to send.

signup_open.description: True when `/join/<slug>` takes signups right now.

bounce_rate.description: Over the last 7 days, the same window auto-pause uses.

Priority.description: Claim order: urgent, then normal, then bulk. The caller picks it.

provider.description: Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, iCloud, Proton or Other.

website.description: Honeypot (the form's `hp_f3a1` input): people never fill it; a filled one gets the normal answer and nothing happens.

open.description: False: show "This newsletter is not taking signups right now."

sent.description: Handed to the sender (everything but queued, failed, skipped and cancelled).

skipped.description: Readers who left or were blocked before their copy went out.

priority.description: urgent (login codes, resets), normal (default) or bulk (newsletters).

send_at.description: When to start; absent or past = now. At most 30 days ahead.

to.description: 1-5 addresses of members of this account.

newsletter_name.description: None when the link is not valid any more; the page still says "You're unsubscribed".

UpdateContactRequest.description: Absent fields stay as they are. An empty name clears it. `fields` and `tags` replace the whole set.

oneOf.description: `unsubscribed`, or `subscribed` for a contact that already is. Pending and unsubscribed contacts cannot be set to `subscribed`.

UpdateNewsletterRequest.description: Absent fields stay as they are; `""` clears a text field.

newsletter_from.description: Must be on a verified domain of this account.

postal_address.description: Shown at the bottom of every issue; sending needs it. `""` clears it.

signup_ask_name.description: Show the first-name field on the signup form.

done.description: Readers whose copy reached a final state.

secret.description: Only returned once, when the webhook is created.
